raw_html: [[Acid Arrow#Sovereign Acid Arrow|Sovereign Acid Arrow]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Acid Arrow#Sovereign Acid Arrow|Sovereign Acid Arrow]]:''' This bow coats your arrows in corrosive acid. A successful hit douses the target in acid causing an additional 20 to 50 damage after two seconds have passed. Each additional hit extends the duration of the acid damage by two seconds.
